edition.notes: The AAS 57 reproduction identifies and transcribes the declaration within the 16 November 1964 Lumen gentium Notificationes. In the first paragraph it prints a comma after 'definit' before 'quae'; the AAS 58 reproduction omits that comma.
edition.publication: Reproduced in Notificationes, Acta Apostolicae Sedis 57 (1965): 72
edition.title: Doctrinal Commission declaration of 6 March 1964 — AAS 57 reproduction

passages.context: The declaration's complete two paragraphs: the first limits definitions to matters openly declared as such, and the second requires reception of the Council's remaining teaching according to its manifested mind and the norms of theological interpretation.
passages.notes: The complete declaration was checked in this AAS 57 reproduction and compared with its AAS 58 reproduction. The witnesses have the same substantive wording; AAS 57 prints a comma after 'definit' that AAS 58 omits.
passages.reason: The rights record states that lawful project access to this artifact does not include redistribution from this repository.

alternate_titles: Declaration of 6 March 1964 on the theological qualification of conciliar teaching
work.author: Second Vatican Council Doctrinal Commission
work.description: The two-paragraph declaration of 6 March 1964 distinguishing matters the Council openly declares to be defined from its remaining teaching, which the faithful receive according to the Council's manifested mind and the norms of theological interpretation. The declaration was reproduced in the separately modeled Lumen gentium and Dei Verbum notifications.
work.title: Doctrinal Commission declaration on conciliar theological qualification
